batch_parent.authority_scope: provisional same-PR batch interface only; hostile audit remains deferred

uses: homogeneous quartic criterion for a 2-isogeny Kummer class
global product formula only as a firewall/checksum

homogeneous_model.alpha_class_scope: d is a squarefree signed representative supported on primes dividing C0
homogeneous_model.beta_class_scope: e is a squarefree signed representative supported on primes dividing 2*D0
homogeneous_model.odd_selected_prime_definition: q is selected when v_q(d)=1 for alpha or v_q(e)=1 for beta

selected_alpha_prime_lemma.negative_t: if t<0, 1+4*t is the unique minimum and is odd, impossible for w^2
selected_alpha_prime_lemma.nonnegative_t: if t>=0, either the last term is the unique odd minimum (impossible) or the middle term is the unique minimum; then the unit residue of w^2 is -2 times a square
selected_alpha_prime_lemma.sufficiency: if (-2/q)=+1, take z=1; modulo q the RHS is -2*S^2, a nonzero square, and Hensel lifts using derivative 2*w nonzero mod q
selected_alpha_prime_lemma.exact_selected_prime_equivalence: alpha cover has a Q_q-point iff (-2/q)=+1

alpha_gaussian_combination.36_09V_alpha_prime_condition: if odd q divides C0 then (2/q)=+1
alpha_gaussian_combination.combined_with_selected_alpha_lemma: selected alpha q must satisfy both (2/q)=+1 and (-2/q)=+1
alpha_gaussian_combination.forbidden_selected_alpha_primes: every q=7 mod 8 dividing C0 is forbidden from the support of a locally soluble alpha Kummer class

explicit_forbidden_witness.conclusion: q=7 cannot be selected in d

explicit_allowed_local_witness.conclusion: q=17 passes the selected-prime local condition; this does not assert a global alpha class

selected_beta_prime_lemma.construction: take z=1; modulo q the beta RHS is 4*S^2, with roots w=+/-2*S; derivative 2*w is nonzero mod q, so Hensel gives a Q_q-point
selected_beta_prime_lemma.result: every odd selected beta prime is automatically locally soluble at its own q-place

receiver_sensitive_reciprocity_status.beta_selected_prime_filter: none at the selected prime itself
receiver_sensitive_reciprocity_status.reason: alpha selected-prime symbols are forced trivial while beta selected self-places are locally soluble without a character restriction; any proof-capable global obstruction must use complementary reservoir primes and/or the 2-adic/infinite places together with the chosen d/e class
